items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I saw one of my neighbors sitting out there, Walter

ctx.x: Now I had never driven a car before in my life, now, but I told her, "Yes ma'am" and I guess the man upstairs must have been smiling on me because He made it possible for this cancellation to happen, because I never heard of this happening before, anyway.

So anyway, I get the learner's permit, rush back uptown, I saw one of my neighbors sitting out there, Walter, and I said to Walter, "What you doing?" and he said, "I ain't doing nothing" so I said, "Well, look, I need someone to sit with me in the car -- for my learner's permit, and would you ride along with me? I'll buy you a bottle", because he liked to drink anyway, so I said I'd buy him a bottle, and he said, "Yeah, I will go -- you don't have to buy me no bottle" -- and I said, "Oh, I'll buy you a bottle…

So he got in the car with me, and I started out, and one of the things that I heard that was very hard to do was learn to park. So every open space I saw, I sat up there trying to park this car.
